hops.note: UBI-245 token method applied against a genuinely empty categories.json (real classification: 0 clean, 0 ambiguous, 444 no-signal, reported before authoring anything). Real signal used: Cloudflare's own 551 human-authored OpenAPI tags, the same signal namespace_from_tags already uses for wire grouping. 426 of 444 tokens normalized directly from real tag text; 18 carried an internal non-human tag and were individually traced to real wire types/paths, collapsing onto 9 real Cloudflare products. Real result: 433 distinct category labels for 1088 wire types, 100% coverage verified both by direct computation and a real ubx-docs-providers sidebar build against a local mirror. Not forced coarser than the real product taxonomy warrants. One key (cloudflare_location) later removed once the wire-type set itself changed -- see write-intros hop's own notes.

Real wire-type set is now 233 resources + 823 data sources (1056 total) -- two ubx-provider-dynamic create-binding fixes landed since categories was authored (see sdk/providers/.onboarding/cloudflare.json in ubiquex for the full account), dropping 268 -> 233 real resources. categories.json's own coverage re-verified against the new set: 966 of 967 keys still needed (cloudflare_location, which never had a real create OR real data source once both fixes landed, removed).

Resource batches 1-4 (commits 70de50c/0e1fbbb/c49d2f5/95f1fbb, merged via PR #2-#5): ALL 233 real resources have an intro, verified by direct set-difference against the authoritative dump-ir resource list. Found and filed as their own ticket (UBI-246, not fixed here -- out of this session's own scope) a real, recurring ubx-provider-dynamic defect: multiple response schemas that legitimately resolve to the identical real create endpoint get independent, unrelated generated names instead of one collapsed/disambiguated name. Complete examples found: AI Gateway (POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/gateways) has 10 generated names (cloudflare_gateway the one correctly-named one, plus cost/custom_domain/custom_provider/dataset/evaluation/log/route/url/version); Artifacts repository (POST .../artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos) has 3 (cloudflare_commit/repo/tree).

Data source batch 1 (commit 6483bc9, on branch artifacts/ds-intros-batch-1): 60/823 data sources (293/1056 total). Real content, read against each data source's own GET path and vendor field descriptions (data sources' own depth-0 fields are mostly query/filter parameters, not a returned entity's own attributes -- intros describe what the listing/lookup actually returns). Started the Access product family alphabetically; several zone-scoped/account-scoped pairs confirmed as the same real listing at two different scopes, cross-referenced in the intro text rather than duplicated.

Remaining: 763/1056 wires still need an intro (all data sources). 2178 depth-0 field descriptions also still missing -- not started yet, intros are the more expensive, non-batchable-for-free work per write-artifacts.md's own framing, prioritized first.
